function.name: personality_assessment_evaluate
function.description: Evaluate and categorize a user's personality type based on a given array of personality trait percentages. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

percentage.description: The percentage representation of the trait in the user's personality.

detailed_output.description: Determines whether the output should include a detailed explanation of the personality type. This is optional.

message.content: 抱歉，我無法在沒有進行正式評估的情況下為您的朋友提供 MBTI 類型。若您能提供關於他/她的性格特質百分比（例如：外向、內向、感知、直覺等），我可以協助您進行評估並給出相應的類型。

According to policy, we must not provide MBTI or personality type without proper assessment. We can ask for more info or explain how to assess. So we should respond that we cannot give MBTI without assessment. We can offer to evaluate if they provide trait percentages. The user didn't provide trait percentages. So we should ask them to provide trait percentages or ask for more info. Also we can mention that we can't provide MBTI without assessment. So we should politely refuse or ask for more info. According to policy, we should not provide MBTI. So we should refuse. But we can offer to evaluate if they provide trait percentages. So we can say: "I can't determine your friend's MBTI without assessment. If you provide trait percentages, I can evaluate." That is allowed. So we should not provide MBTI. We'll comply with policy.
